zusammenfassung: This week AI shifts from individual outputs to controllable execution. Writer optimises the cost structure of agentic text work, Claude Code combines autonomy with an additional safety mechanism. For visual teams, precise editing becomes more important than another prompt lottery ticket. Muse Glimmer shows how local open weights put data protection and control back into one's own hands.
highlights: Muse Glimmer and Claude Code Auto Mode (9/10)
Trend: from generated single results to controllable, context-aware workflows
Shift: from all-in-one to specialised solutions
trend: From single outputs to controllable workflows: cost, permissions, context and safety mechanisms become the real product quality.
